# Provenance

This directory is copied from Google DeepMind's MuJoCo Menagerie:

- Repository: <https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco_menagerie>
- Commit: `822c2d8f877dd166c5b7d3c9f7e3c3b6589473b7`
- Source directory: `franka_emika_panda/`
- License: Apache-2.0; see `LICENSE` in this directory.

The files are vendored so Mac and later Linux/GPU runs compile the same robot
model without downloading mutable external assets.
